description: When the tab's pending request hits OPERATION_INTEGRITY_CONFLICT, the page banner offers only 'Retry saved request', which fails the same way every time. Dismiss is hidden, New task is disabled, every other change is refused with 'Resolve the saved request before starting another change.', and the state survives reload. The only exit is closing the tab.
expected: OPERATION_INTEGRITY_CONFLICT is treated as definitive: the pending request is cleared (or Discard is offered) and the person is pointed to the task's conflict section.
actual: Stuck pending request with Retry only
suggested_fix: Add OPERATION_INTEGRITY_CONFLICT to the definitive error list (as OPERATION_ID_REUSED already is) and always offer Discard for a pending request.

description: The Unresolved operation ID conflict section has no action at all: nothing to acknowledge, choose or dismiss, in the UI or the CLI. The amber warning stays on the task forever, even though both variants were applied.
expected: An 'Acknowledge' / 'Mark reviewed' action that records an operator decision, or guidance on what to do next.
suggested_fix: Add an operator acknowledgement operation and button; explain that both changes already applied.

description: Variant summaries read 'task.update by actor-<64 hex> — <64 hex fingerprint>'. They wrap mid-token over three lines and never name the Actor ('Maya Okafor', 'Juniper'). The bodies are raw JSON.
expected: 'Maya Okafor changed Status Up next → In progress' / 'Juniper changed Priority P1 → P0', with the raw JSON behind a 'Technical details' disclosure.
suggested_fix: Render variants with the same Actor and field formatters as History; keep the fingerprint in the details.

description: The board card shows no marker for an integrity conflict, unlike 'Conflicting edits' for field conflicts, so an operator alerted elsewhere has to open tasks one by one.
expected: A card marker such as 'Retry key conflict'.
suggested_fix: Show a card label when task context has integrityConflicts.

description: A network failure on a write shows the browser's raw 'Failed to fetch' as the error title.
expected: 'Couldn't reach your Pardner service. Your change is saved in this tab; retry when it is running.'
suggested_fix: Map fetch TypeErrors to a service-unreachable message.
